tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The court in which the individual was accused or convicted; if the felony charge was dismissed, the superior court in the county where the arrest occurred.

destination.name: Clerk of the accusing or convicting court, or the superior court of the county of arrest where the charge was dismissed
destination.detail: Notice to the arresting law enforcement agency and the prosecuting attorney, which is broader than the other § 35-3-37(j) routes. Hearing within 90 days if requested.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The court in which the individual was convicted.

destination.name: Clerk of the convicting court
destination.detail: Notice to the prosecuting attorney. Hearing within 90 days if requested.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The court in which the charged offence is pending.

destination.name: Clerk of the court in which the charged offence is pending
destination.detail: Notice to the prosecuting attorney. Hearing within 90 days if requested.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The court in which the conviction occurred, which retains jurisdiction over the case for this limited purpose. In practice a State Court or a Superior Court, and possibly a Magistrate, Probate or Municipal court where a state-law offence was tried there.

destination.name: Clerk of the convicting court
destination.detail: Filed in the existing criminal case under the existing case number. E-filing where the court accepts it. Serve the prosecuting attorney; Georgia Justice Project practice also serves the clerk of court.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The superior court in the county where the arrest occurred. This route names the superior court expressly, unlike the routes that follow the accusing or convicting court.

destination.name: Superior court in the county where the arrest occurred
destination.detail: Notice to the arresting law enforcement agency and the prosecuting attorney. Hearing within 90 days if requested.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The court in which the conviction occurred.

destination.name: Clerk of the convicting court
destination.detail: Filed in the existing criminal case. Served on the prosecuting attorney; hearing within 90 days if requested.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The court with original jurisdiction over the offences in the county where the clerk of court is located. This is a different venue formula from the misdemeanour-conviction route, which is the convicting court; for a non-conviction there was no conviction, so the § 35-3-37(m) formula governs.

destination.name: Clerk of the court with original jurisdiction over the offences in the county where the clerk is located
destination.detail: Filed in the underlying criminal case. Notice to the clerk of court and the prosecuting attorney.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The court that ordered the First Offender sentence, in the existing criminal case.

destination.name: Clerk of the court that handled the underlying case
destination.detail: Filed as a criminal petition in the existing case. Notice to the clerk of court and the prosecuting District Attorney or Solicitor-General for the county.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Edition 1.2 Georgia addendum, amended statement 5: no statewide judiciary form exists for any Georgia court petition, so every petition route carries localFormOverride and the statewide neutral pleading is the controlling output rather than a fallback.
tracks.venueAuthority: Statewide statute. The court that granted the discharge, in the existing criminal case.

destination.name: Clerk of the court that granted the discharge
destination.detail: Filed as a criminal petition in the existing case. Notice to the clerk of court and the prosecuting District Attorney or Solicitor-General for the county.
